//: EXAMPLE: a plain document/chunk RAG index (Option B - grounding only).
These field names match what Azure AI Search's 'Import and vectorize data' wizard produces.
Change them to match the customer index, then point at this file:
Or load it alongside a structured-records declaration (see index-schema.structured.example.json):
Exactly ONE declaration in the registry may carry `mapping.grounding` - it is the corpus the
NOTE files named *.example.json are SKIPPED when a directory is expanded, so copy this file to
a new name (e.g. rag-index.json) before dropping it into a config directory.
Check it before running anything against Azure:
NOTE there is no `mapping.entityType` and no `mapping.payload`. This corpus holds text, not
structured contact/event/leader records, so on its own it cannot drive the deterministic trip
planner and only the `search_grounding` tool is registered. NOTHING is read from the demo seed.
NEVER run `provision:search ensure|sync|reindex` against a customer index - `ensure` would try
to reshape it and `sync` would push demo records into it. `validate` is offline and safe.

//grounding: content  REQUIRED, must be `searchable` - the passage text an answer is grounded in.
parentId optional, must be `filterable` - collapses many chunks of one document to its best
passage, so a long PDF cannot occupy every result slot.
vector   optional, must be Collection(Edm.Single) - turns recall hybrid (BM25 + kNN + RRF).
The index needs a vectorizer on its vector profile so queries can pass raw text.
semanticConfiguration optional - adds the semantic L2 reranker. Requires Basic tier or above.
